requirements.evidence: Catalog has no sewing-specific props (sewing/thread/fabric search returned 0). Used available workshop proxies: pliers, gaffer tape (as thread/tape roll), marker, screwdriver staged in bins to show compartmented use. Sewing-specific visuals unmet due to catalog limits.

finish.summary: 3-cell organizer with two full-depth divided bins and one half-depth tray, plus rod accessories for thread handling. Dressed with representative tools/props; no sewing-specific props exist in catalog.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Sewing supplies — I'll put together something tidy to keep everything in order.
